_comment: Copy to voice_rules.json and edit. Rules are how the voice-lint tool enforces YOUR writing voice. 'hard' rules are pass/fail (fix to zero before delivery); 'soft' rules only report density; 'report' rules are listed for a human decision and never counted; 'headings' is one regex applied to Markdown/Typst heading lines (sentence-form or question titles → rewrite as noun phrases; set to "" to disable). Each rule = [label, python-regex]; soft rules take an optional 3rd number = per-1000-char density threshold. Build these from YOUR own writing habits — what YOU never do (see templates/VOICE_PROFILE.template.md). Below are generic Chinese-academic defaults to start from.
hard: Em-dash / double-hyphen (should be 0 in formal zh prose)
恰恰是|之所在|價值所在|真正的[^，。]{0,8}(在於|重量|價值)
那份由|那份[表單資料紀錄]|那個[步驟東西部分問題]|這個東西
此一|這一類|這一場|這一種|這一項
(?<!「)(?:綜觀全案|綜上所述|總而言之|整體而言|由此觀之|一言以蔽之|總的來說|大體而言)(?!」)
soft: 一[具個種套位條場道份隻]
report: (?<!「)(?:關鍵作用|扮演著|多維度|標誌著|生態系統|愈發|深厚的|持久的|奠定了?基礎)(?!」)
_paper: Used only with --paper (papers, grant proposals, applications). Those follow the register of same-field journal papers, not your voice, so drop the rules that are your personal habit but common in journal papers, and move some to report-only. 'drop' lists label prefixes of hard rules to remove; 'hard' and 'report' are appended. Check your field with tools/zh-tw/zh_register.py before adding more drops: the semicolon, 乃, 則是 and 抑或 are common in Taiwan journal papers.

hard: (?<!「)(?:綜觀全案|總而言之|由此觀之|一言以蔽之|總的來說|大體而言)(?!」)
report: Summary closers (paper mode: report only, do not add new ones)
